# The restart is approved and applied, but the service stays unhealthy for the whole time of the row (5 minutes, one second each here). The desk restores the saved state,
# pages the commander and holds the incident. No postmortem draft is written, and the ops system does not get the state mitigated.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

incidentinit
incidentfakes
subst home/.incident/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env INCIDENT_DIR=$WORK/ops
env INCIDENT_MINUTE_SECONDS=60
env INCIDENT_ROUNDS=2
env INCIDENT_ROUND_SECONDS=1

stdin alert.json
exec sh ops/scripts/spool-alert.sh
exec obeereal item add incident watch-1 --title 'Watch' --body-file body.txt
exec obeereal run watch-1 incident --workflow ops/workflow.star &
waitstatus 'paused: [primary] Approve restart'
exec obeereal answer incident-2 approve: ann
wait
stdout 'item watch-1 finished'

grep -count=1 '^restart incident-2-restart$' writes.log
grep -count=1 '^checkout rollback-incident-2-restart$' restores.log
grep 'restart did not restore health in 5 minutes; earlier state restored: True' home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/timeline.tsv
grep -count=1 '^incident-2 commander$' pages.log
! exists status.log
! exists home/.incident/postmortems/incident-2.md

-- body.txt --
The watch.
-- alert.json --
{"fingerprint":"v1","severity":"sev1","title":"Checkout errors","service":"checkout","detail":"RESTART the pods hang"}
-- home/.incident/config --
OPS_API=http://ops.test
SPOOL=@WORK@/home/.incident/spool
INC_POLL=1
INC_MINUTE=1
INC_TICK=1
-- home/.incident/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
-- resp/_services_checkout_metrics --
{"error_rate":0.4}
-- resp/_services_checkout_deploys --
[]
-- resp/_services_checkout_logs --
line one
-- resp/_services_checkout_state --
{"version":"v413","replicas":3}
-- resp/_services_checkout_health --
{"healthy":false}
